description: Changes to information processing facilities and systems are not subject to change management procedures. This signal indicates that system modifications, configuration changes, software updates, or infrastructure changes are performed without formal approval, testing, documentation, or rollback procedures.
applicability: Applicable to all changes affecting information systems including application code changes, infrastructure modifications, configuration updates, security patches, network changes, database schema modifications, and access control changes. Covers both planned changes and emergency changes.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of change management policies, change approval workflows, change logs and records, deployment procedures, rollback capabilities, and incident analysis. May also be identified through absence of change control boards, approval gates, or change tracking systems.
